steps.title: Conduct Scoping Search
steps.instruction: Perform a systematic search across multiple databases and grey literature using specific search terms and MESH headings to identify sources relevant to KMb strategies in dementia research within primary care.

substeps.instruction: Search EBSCO (including CINAHL Plus, APA PsycINFO, APA PsycArticles, Medline), Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library.

Use the search string: (knowledge mobili#ation OR research mobili#ation OR knowledge utili#ation OR knowledge exchange OR knowledge transfer OR knowledge translation OR knowledge broker* OR knowledge dissemination OR knowledge sharing OR co-creation OR co-design OR co-production OR communities of practice OR community of practice) AND (dementia OR Alzheimer* OR Vascular Dementia OR mild cognitive impairment OR MCI OR memory loss) AND (primary care OR primary health care OR primary healthcare OR general practice OR GP OR pharmac* OR medical practice OR family practice OR family physician OR family doctor OR outpatient).
Search from the first available date in each database until the day of the search.
Perform backward and forward citation screening.

steps.title: Screen and Select Literature
steps.instruction: Filter the identified sources based on predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria.

substeps.instruction: Include papers, reports, recommendations, or guidance relating to KMb of dementia research in primary care, available in English, providing at least a description of a KMb strategy.

Exclude sources focused on general staff training, education for people living with dementia/family carers, residential or secondary care settings without primary care involvement, broad recommendations for future research, participatory research methods without KMb strategy descriptions, literature reviews/study protocols without KMb strategy descriptions, conference abstracts, sources where dementia is part of a broader population, inaccessible sources, or irrelevant content.

steps.title: Manage and Screen Results
steps.instruction: Process the search results using Rayyan software to refine the final list of included studies.

substeps.instruction: Export search results to Rayyan software and automatically remove duplicates.
Perform title and abstract screening by Reviewer 1, with a randomly selected 20% reviewed by Reviewer 2.
Perform full text screening by Reviewer 1, with a randomly selected 20% reviewed by Reviewer 2.
Resolve any disagreements at either stage through discussion with Reviewer 3.

steps.title: Extract and Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Extract relevant information from the selected sources and perform a thematic analysis.

substeps.instruction: Enter extracted data into a pre-designed form.
Conduct a thematic analysis of the extracted data to identify themes according to research objectives.
Critically analyze included sources to understand KMb strategies and evidence for their effectiveness.
